contentBlocks.text: ਦਰਿਆ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਖੇਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। (Rivers give water, and water grows fields.) Today, real vocabulary for Punjab's farmland.

New words: ਖੇਤ (khet, field/farm), ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ (khetibaari, farming/agriculture), ਕਣਕ (kanak, wheat), and ਜ਼ਮੀਨ (zameen, land). Punjab's rivers make its ਜ਼ਮੀਨ excellent for ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ, and ਕਣਕ is one of its most important crops. Write 2 sentences describing Punjab's farmland, using at least two of today's new words.
You now have real vocabulary for Punjab's farmland and agriculture. Tomorrow we'll learn about one of its most famous cities: Amritsar.

objectives: Learn 4 new vocabulary words for Punjab's farmland: ਖੇਤ, ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ, ਕਣਕ, ਜ਼ਮੀਨ
Write 2 sentences connecting rivers to farmland using the new vocabulary
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's river vocabulary.
2. Introduce today's 4 new farmland words, connecting rivers to farming.
3. Have the child write 2 sentences using at least 2 new words.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's topic: Amritsar.
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow the child to use just ਖੇਤ and ਕਣਕ (the two most concrete words) rather than all 4
Ready for more: ask them to explain in their own words why rivers matter for farming
All Gurmukhi words used in this lesson were validated against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. ਖੇਤ = field/farm. 2. ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ = farming/agriculture. 3. ਕਣਕ = wheat. 4. ਜ਼ਮੀਨ = land.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Continues building the course's 'geography of Punjab' vocabulary, connecting Day 1's rivers to their real agricultural significance for the region.

generationData.instructions: Write the English meaning of each Gurmukhi word.
